Vendored three.js builds (MIT, SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT,
Copyright 2010-2024 Three.js Authors)

- three.module.min.js  — three r170 module build, from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.min.js
- OrbitControls.js     — three r170 OrbitControls addon, from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js

Served by the web app as static scripts:
- /static/three.module.js
- /static/orbit-controls.js

The app keeps its zero-runtime-npm-dependency rule: the pinned builds are committed here instead of
installed, and the license headers are preserved in the files themselves.
